title: Type layout lookup
description: Query normalized PPC-EABI record layouts for duplicate structs, near layouts, union aliases, and cast-only overlays.
status_message: Queries use a prebuilt type-layout index; when absent, the server can build a cast-free worktree cache from sandbox build/ctx.c.
limitations: Layout evidence reflects the build/ctx.c used at index time and must be rebuilt after relevant type changes.
Sandbox fetch-first indexes omit source cast scanning; rebuild from a host checkout to enable casts mode.

usage.agent_guidance: Use when field offsets or overlay interpretations are uncertain; treat results as layout evidence tied to the indexed build context.
